lamp.name: The Lamp
lamp.line: A small light is enough to see the next step. Tend it today.

lotus.name: The Lotus
lotus.line: What grows from the mud is not stained by it. Let something bloom from a hard place.

sword.name: The Sword
sword.line: Cut one thread that no longer serves you. Clean cuts heal fastest.

garland.name: The Garland
garland.line: Every ending has taught you something. Count the lessons, not the losses.

eye.name: The Third Eye
eye.line: Look past the first answer. The second one is truer.

crescent.name: The Crescent
crescent.line: Something is beginning quietly. Do not rush it into the light.

bell.name: The Bell
bell.line: Call your attention home. Begin again exactly where you are.

river.name: The River
river.line: Let it move. What is meant to stay will not be carried away.

serpent.name: The Serpent
serpent.line: Old skin is falling away. Rest while the new one hardens.

night.name: The Night
night.line: In the dark nothing needs to be performed. Be still and be held.

dawn.name: The Dawn
dawn.line: You have already come through the darkest part of the night.

fire.name: The Fire
fire.line: Offer one thing to the fire today: a fear, a habit, a word left unsaid.
